free_cases_pool.title: Case #105 — The Midnight Melody of Room 302

timeline.author: Library_Yuki
timeline.message: I was returning overdue reference books to the 3F archive just now. Room 302 (the old music classroom that's been locked since 2012) had faint piano notes coming from inside. It was playing a 4-bar minor chord progression over and over.

timeline.author: Track_Captain_Ren
timeline.message: @Library_Yuki bro Room 302 doesn't even have a piano anymore?? They moved all upright pianos to the B1 storage locker last semester during the renovation!!

timeline.author: NightOwl_33
timeline.message: I walked past the courtyard glass around 6:00 AM and heard the same melody echoing down through the rain spouts.

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: We picked up the vibration on our room mic down in Sub-Level 04. It's radiating straight through the air duct connected to Room 302. Pitch is tuned to exactly 432Hz.

timeline.author: Yumi_BioLab
timeline.message: The audio sensors in 2F hall recorded an energy spike right as the melody stopped. The frequency resonance matches old 1990s magnetic audio tape.

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi found a torn sheet music scrap tucked inside the 1994 yearbook on the Lore page! Check the radio ticker for clue word 1: SIGNAL!

timeline.author: Daiki_StudentGov
timeline.message: Reminder: 3F Hallway is cordoned off for electrical testing. Please do not attempt to enter Room 302.

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: UPDATE: If anyone can decipher the chord code and enter it into the Mystery Decoder tab, we can feed the matching synth note through Neko FM to ground the signal!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: I entered my daily code into the Mystery Decoder tab and unlocked a new letter for my target word! Check your Student ID tail!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: The air ducts are vibrating again... if you guys find the code in the Lore Library archives, put it in the BBS terminal tab before midnight!!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: The resonance in SL-04 is reaching peak amplitude! Weekend investigators, enter your final solved word into the Decoder tab to claim your badge!

timeline.author: Library_Yuki
timeline.message: The piano notes are fading out... entering the correct passcode matched the ghost chord progression to an unreleased 1994 track!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: [CASE #105 RESOLVED REPORT] Code HARMONY_1994 verified! Ghost melody grounded. Unredacted spectrograph analysis locked to Board 03 for VIP Backstage Pass members.

timeline.author: Aoi_Pres
timeline.message: Sub-Level 04 iron gate resonance frequency recorded at 14.2kHz. Clearance Level 3 required for investigation.

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: The spectrograph behind the sealed iron gate is registering harmonic feedback matching the Room 302 piano track.

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: VIP Clue Unlocked: Check the spectrograph log in the radio chat line for the Sub-Level 04 gate passcode.

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Sub-Level 04 vault doors unlocked for all VIP Backstage Pass holders!
